auditMethod.visual: Manual review of the full source board and all eight poses in row-major order against the merged Deacon lock and the visually inspected V56 predecessor.
auditMethod.technical: Standalone PNG/Pillow inspection of dimensions, RGB/alpha distribution, nominal-cell hashes, foreground bounds, margins and local support pixels. No global report, queue, state, normalizer, atlas or runtime file was written.

facing.note: All eight Deacons face right in readable gameplay side profile.

identity.note: Pronounced mitre cranium, eyeless navy-blue organic biped, long clawed limbs, exactly two arms and two legs, no tail and no dorsal tubes remain consistent. The dark rib definition is retained as organic muscle, not certified film-exact biomechanical material.

anatomy.note: No Ultramorph giant/pale anatomy, Big Chap dome, Neomorph crown, Queen crest, equipment, armor, extra limb or visible eye was found.

chronology.note: Eight unique grounded alert/breath poses progress through upright, forward lean, crouch and recovery. Crouch amplitude in frames 4-6 is intentionally flagged for later animated-loop review rather than silently accepted.

contacts.note: After a documented 52 px bottom-row translation, all eight nominal cells share local support pixel y=428 with at least 14 px bottom gutter.

magentaFlatten.method: Four-connected flood fill from canvas borders over magenta-family pixels, then replacement with opaque RGB #FF00FF.

limitations: The active source is an ImageGen-derived candidate with a documented non-pixel-preserving ImageGen canvas repair, followed by deterministic background and placement corrections; it is not a pristine raw provider output.
Only idle exists. Interclip anatomical scale, move/attack/death chronology, normalized contacts, GIF seam and runtime behavior remain unreviewed.
The project Deacon Line extrapolates one screen individual; the output is not certified film-exact or canon-exact.
No queue, state, global reference registry, normalizer, runtime manifest, test or Git state was modified.
